parameters.name: NewResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the new resource group.

You can log on to the [Resource Management console](https://resourcemanager.console.aliyun.com/resource-groups?) to view resource group IDs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the zone.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~2412111~~) operation to query the latest region list.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type.

Set the value to filesystem.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas change-resource-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id 31a8e40000 --new-resource-group-id rg-acfmwavnfdf0000 --resource-type filesystem --region cn-hangzhou
